adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new membership logic in `Admin::GroupsController#add_members` that parses a comma-separated string and silently ignores unknown usernames (`usernames.split(",").each do |username|; if user = User.find_by_username(username); group.add(user); end; end`). The accompanying spec only covers (1) rejecting automatic groups and (2) adding two valid users, but does not cover mixed valid/invalid usernames or duplicates, nor assert what happens when some entries are ignored. That’s a concrete, diff-grounded missing-test/edge-case coverage concern rather than a directly verifiable defect.
